worcester-sauce.ingredientAwareness: Fermented condiment liquid; check labels for hidden garlic, onion, and molasses ingredients.

xylitol.ingredientAwareness: A sugar alcohol (polyol) sweetener that acts as a strong osmotic laxative and triggers severe IBS symptoms.

yam.electronAwareness: True yams are starchy tubers; ensure they are not confused with sweet potatoes (kumara).

yam-flour.ingredientAwareness: Milled true yam flour providing starchy carbohydrate bases.

yardlong-bean.ingredientAwareness: Long green beans containing moderate oligosaccharides; monitor portion weights.

yeast-dried.ingredientAwareness: Active dry baking yeast is used to leaven bread; pure yeast does not introduce FODMAPs.

zucchini.ingredientAwareness: Courgette/zucchini is a versatile green squash with wonderful low-FODMAP serving allowances before minor polyols accumulate.
